photos.title: Willbrook Plantation from above
photos.what: Willbrook Plantation from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): houses on large wooded lots along a lake and the Willbrook golf course, with fairways, a green and bunkers, and a road crossing the top.
photos.caption: Part of Willbrook Plantation from the air: houses on large lots along a lake and the golf course.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of part of Willbrook Plantation in Pawleys Island: houses on large wooded lots along a lake and beside golf course fairways, a green and sand bunkers
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-14; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the NAIP records of /submarkets/myrtle-beach/plantation-point/ (data/2026-11-d/plantation-point/photos.json) and /submarkets/garden-city/: The National Map offers free downloads of public domain NAIP orthoimagery; the USDA FSA policy page says public domain information may be freely distributed or copied, with credit requested.
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS).
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from the NAIP service and cropped it to 4:3
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /submarkets/pawleys-island/willbrook-plantation/ on 2026-11-14. Of the 56 building outlines in the frame on the county's map, 50 sit on Willbrook-named lots; the other 6 are golf club buildings and sheds along the top edge, on the course parcel. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
photos.crop_note: Crops cut from the center of a second export of the same frame at 1800 x 1391 (crop_source_request) by tools/photos.js crops, for Article.image and the share image.
